kjv: that ye should not obey the truth … crucified among you
mine: It was before your eyes that Jesus Christ was publicly portrayed as crucified
note: TR adds "te aletheia me peithesthai" (from 5:7) and "en hymin"; absent from Sinaiticus, A, B, D*, F, G.

kjv: the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ
mine: a covenant previously ratified by God
note: TR adds "eis Christon"; absent from P46, Sinaiticus, A, B, C.

kjv: the law was our schoolmaster [to bring us] unto Christ
mine: the law was our guardian until Christ came
note: paidagogos was the slave who supervised a child, not a teacher; and "eis Christon" is temporal ("until Christ"), as 3:23, 25 show, not "to bring us to Christ" (KJV italics).
